featured_reviews.review_text:
Design & Variety: Does the store lean toward a specific aesthetic (e.g., Mid-Century Modern, Industrial, Traditional)? Note if they offer a good mix of "statement pieces" and functional basics.
Build Quality: Pay attention to the materials. Are the drawers solid wood with dovetail joints, or is there a lot of particleboard? Check the "sturdiness" of floor models.
Showroom Experience: A good store should have curated "room sets" that help you visualize the furniture in your own home. Is it easy to navigate, or is it a cluttered warehouse?
Price vs. Value: Compare the price tags to the expected longevity of the items. Is this "buy it for life" furniture or "starter home" furniture?
Delivery & Assembly: Mention the lead times. Is it in stock today, or is there a 12-week wait?
